profile.headline: Technical Lead | Solution Architect | AWS Cloud & Serverless Architecture | Cross-Functional Technical Leadership | Event-Driven Systems | AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary:
Technical Lead and AWS Solutions Architect with 12+ years of experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise applications in financial services. I partner across business units, engineering teams, architecture groups, and product organizations to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions and modernization strategies. I specialize in AWS cloud-native and serverless architecture, React, TypeScript, API design, and distributed systems. 

As a Technical Lead, I serve as a technical multiplier by leading discovery efforts, defining solution approaches, aligning cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and driving delivery from architecture through production support. I turn business goals into target architecture and actionable plans, lead discovery and estimation ahead of delivery, mentor engineers, and own outcomes from design through release and production support. I work closely with product, delivery, and peer technical leads to align roadmaps, manage cross-team dependencies, and keep stakeholders informed about progress, risks, and decisions. 

While I lead technical direction and architecture decisions, I remain a hands-on engineer, contributing to design, implementation, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support.

I regularly collaborate across business units, architects, product teams, and engineering organizations to resolve dependencies, evaluate technical trade-offs, align roadmaps, and ensure successful execution of enterprise initiatives.

I care about engineering excellence: healthy CI/CD pipelines, shift-left security, strong testing practices, and clear, current architecture documentation. 

I help introduce AI-assisted development practices, contribute to internal InnerSource AI initiatives, and build automation that reduces manual effort and improves delivery. 

Areas of expertise:

• AWS Cloud & Serverless Architecture
• Solution Architecture
• Application Modernization
• Event-Driven Architecture
• Distributed Systems
• REST API Design
• React, Next.js & TypeScript
• Technical Leadership
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Technical Discovery & Estimation
• AI-Assisted Engineering
• Developer Productivity & Automation
• DevSecOps
• Observability & Reliability

AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, and AWS Certified AI Practitioner with a passion for solving complex engineering challenges and building systems that are scalable, secure, and maintainable.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Lead hands-on architecture, design, development, and delivery of cloud-native applications using AWS, React, TypeScript, and serverless technologies while coordinating technical execution across multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Define and implement solution architectures for scalable REST APIs, event-driven integrations, and distributed systems supporting enterprise business capabilities across multiple business domains.

• Drive modernization initiatives by evaluating current-state capabilities, identifying future-state architecture patterns, and leading adoption of scalable cloud-native solutions.

• Lead technical discovery, solution evaluation, estimation, and architecture planning efforts for strategic initiatives and modernization programs.

• Partner with architects, product owners, delivery leaders, and engineering teams across business units to resolve dependencies, align technical direction, and achieve shared business outcomes.

• Facilitate architecture discussions, technical reviews, and design decision-making to promote scalability, maintainability, security, and operational excellence.

• Actively contribute to software development, code reviews, troubleshooting, production support, technical documentation, and release readiness.

• Collaborate with architects, product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams to define technical solutions, evaluate design trade-offs, and align implementation with long-term architecture goals.

• Improve application reliability, resiliency, security, monitoring, and operational excellence through automation, cloud best practices, and continuous improvement.

• Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers while staying actively involved in implementation and delivery.

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices, developer productivity tooling, automation, and InnerSource AI initiatives to improve software delivery and engineering effectiveness.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led design and development of full-stack applications supporting digital investing and wealth management platforms, driving technical solutions from requirements through production delivery.

• Led technical design discussions and solution reviews, helping teams evaluate implementation approaches and make informed technology decisions.

• Collaborated across engineering, product, and business teams to manage dependencies, align priorities, and successfully deliver strategic initiatives.

• Designed and implemented scalable APIs, backend services, and customer-facing application features with a focus on performance, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

• Played a key role in platform modernization and cloud adoption initiatives, helping evolve legacy capabilities toward more scalable and resilient architecture patterns.

• Collaborated closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to evaluate requirements, balance technical trade-offs, and deliver business-focused solutions.

• Owned production support, application stability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure reliable customer experiences.

• Worked across multiple functional areas to align business goals, technology solutions, and delivery priorities within a rapidly evolving fintech environment.
